summary: Xie et al. 2021 (eLife), Smart-seq2 of FACS-sorted Drosophila olfactory projection neurons at 0 h, 24 h and 48 h APF and adult (GEO GSE161228; not previously in VFB). 6 Samples (sorts: 0 h VT033006; 48 h and adult GH146; kn+ at 24 h, 48 h, adult) with 27 plate Assays, linked to their driver alleles (GENO has_genotype); the main analysis's 24 h cells are Li et al. 2017's, whose 5 Samples are reused. Seven Clusterings (the main pan-PN analysis and the knot analysis, per stage) with one Cluster per stage x the authors' PN type: 118, 92 loaded (adult PN type terms of the authors' lineage from 48 h APF; at 0 h / 24 h the stage-neutral lineage class until FBbt #2220 adds pupal terms), 26 held. Summary expression as CPM from the authors' h5ads (17,452 genes x 4,097 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.
Load the main pan-PN analysis and the knot analysis (an additional experiment), one Clustering per stage of each; not the 24 h decoding analysis (validation).
The main analysis's 24 h cells are Li et al. 2017's: curate Li 2017 first and reuse its Samples (entity reuse rule).
Immature terms up to the pupal stage (0 h, 24 h APF), mature from the pharate adult stage; ambiguous author types to their common parent.

FBbt term request for the pupal (immature, or remodelling for embryonic-born PNs) PN types and a pupal APL cell term, with Li 2017's (FlyBase/drosophila-anatomy-developmental-ontology#2220); meanwhile the 0 h / 24 h types map to the stage-neutral PN class of their lineage (antennal lobe projection neuron adPN / of ALl1 lineage / vPN), broad; the APL clusters there held.

Stages by the Bainbridge & Bownes FBdv definitions (0 h APF prepupal stage P1); tissue brain to the pupal stage, adult brain from the pharate adult stage; sex not given (unset); samples from crosses link the alleles FlyBase curated for the paper, the kn+ sorts the full intersection (kn-GAL4, GH146-Flp, UAS-FRT-STOP-FRT-mCD8GFP).
Samples by build_samples.py from the GEO family SOFT file (one GSM per cell; the live endpoint fails for this series): one Sample per sort (title group), one Assay per plate.

Clusters by build_clusters.py from the h5ads: one per analysis x stage x PN_type; held: unassigned cells (nan) and numbered MARS_<n> types (untyped). Type mappings by write_type_mappings.py: the adult term of the authors' lineage (per-cell lineage counts and, for kn+ PNs, the paper's statement recorded in the justifications).
Expression from the h5ads' log2(CPM + 1), converted back to CPM, cells assigned by the memberships (h5ad route with expression.h5ad_files); gene symbols mapped to current FlyBase genes.
All 92 mapped clusters reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).
